info.name: Get an order by ID or search orders

params.name: RecipeID
params.description: Your public RecipeID from the Gooten Admin.

params.name: Id
params.description: The Safe Order ID of a specific order to retrieve.

params.name: partnerBillingKey
params.description: Your private Partner Billing Key, URL-encoded. Never expose this client-side.

items.docs: Retrieves a single order by its Safe Order ID (pass `Id`), or searches orders by criteria such as last name, email, postal code, and date range when `Id` is omitted. Search requires the PartnerBillingKey.

params.name: RecipeID
params.description: Your public RecipeID from the Gooten Admin.

items.docs: Submits a new manufacturing order. Requires ship-to and billing addresses, one or more line items (SKU, quantity, artwork images, and a ship type or carrier method), and a Payment object carrying the PartnerBillingKey. Returns the new order Id.

info.name: Get billing information for an order

params.name: orderid
params.description: The order ID to retrieve billing for.

params.name: RecipeID
params.description: Your public RecipeID from the Gooten Admin.

params.name: partnerBillingKey
params.description: Your private Partner Billing Key, URL-encoded. Never expose this client-side.

items.docs: Returns the full billing breakdown for an order - product cost, per-item shipping cost, subtotal, shipping, surcharges, taxes, fees, discounts, and total. Requires the PartnerBillingKey.

info.name: Update the shipping address for an order

params.name: RecipeID
params.description: Your public RecipeID from the Gooten Admin.

params.name: partnerBillingKey
params.description: Your private Partner Billing Key, URL-encoded. Never expose this client-side.

items.docs: Updates the ship-to address on an existing order, provided the order is still in an editable status. Requires the PartnerBillingKey.

info.name: Update the shipping method for order items

params.name: RecipeID
params.description: Your public RecipeID from the Gooten Admin.

params.name: partnerBillingKey
params.description: Your private Partner Billing Key, URL-encoded. Never expose this client-side.

items.docs: Changes the shipping method for one or more items in an order. Shipping method changes automatically adjust order pricing. Requires the PartnerBillingKey.
